topic: LeWorldModel 技术谱系：JEPA 潜空间世界模型到规划控制

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): The user narrowed the review to the LeWorldModel lineage. Static world-model taxonomy needs exact LeWM names, its anti-collapse mechanism, direct planning follow-ups, and negative/evaluation surfaces.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-lewm-exact
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover the focal paper, direct variants, follow-ups, and papers that evaluate or reuse LeWM.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-fast-lewm
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture the direct multi-horizon/prefix-prediction response to LeWM rollout cost and error accumulation.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-lewm-amortized-planning
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"Latent Geometry Beyond Search" OR (all:"LeWorldModel" AND all:"inverse dynamics")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture learned inverse-dynamics planning that replaces online search in a pretrained LeWM latent space.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-lejepa-sigreg
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"LeJEPA" OR all:"Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization" OR all:"SIGReg"
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover the anti-collapse theory and regularizer inherited by LeWM.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-end-to-end-jepa-world-model
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:JEPA OR all:"joint embedding predictive") AND all:"world model" AND (all:"end-to-end" OR all:pixels)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find end-to-end predictive-embedding world models and alternatives to frozen foundation encoders.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-jepa-collapse-limit
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:JEPA OR all:"joint embedding") AND (all:collapse OR all:stability OR all:regularization) AND (all:dynamics OR all:video)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find collapse, stability, and geometry critiques relevant to LeWM's core training claim.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-latent-planning-mpc
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"latent world model" AND (all:planning OR all:MPC OR all:"cross entropy method") AND (all:pixel OR all:visual)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Map the planning mechanism and comparable latent-space planners.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-latent-rollout-error
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"latent dynamics" AND (all:"error accumulation" OR all:"multi-step" OR all:"long horizon") AND (all:planning OR all:control)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover evidence on autoregressive rollout drift and multi-step alternatives.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-latent-cost-alignment
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"latent distance" AND (all:goal OR all:cost) AND (all:planning OR all:control)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Test when distance in a learned latent space is aligned with task progress and control utility.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-action-fidelity-jepa
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:JEPA OR all:"predictive embedding") AND all:action AND (all:fidelity OR all:counterfactual OR all:control)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover action sensitivity, counterfactual futures, and decision utility rather than visual prediction alone.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-dino-wm-pldm
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"DINO-WM" OR all:"planning with latent dynamics models" OR all:PLDM
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover LeWM's frozen-backbone and prior end-to-end planning baselines.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-vjepa-robot-planning
dynamic_suggestions.query: (all:"V-JEPA 2" OR all:"V-JEPA") AND (all:robot OR all:planning OR all:control)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Provide the video-JEPA predecessor and its action-conditioned robotics bridge.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-latent-world-model-efficiency
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:"latent world model" AND (all:efficient OR all:lightweight OR all:"real-time") AND (all:planning OR all:control)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Audit LeWM's efficiency and deployment-relevance claims under comparable planning budgets.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-lewm-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs ("LeWorldModel" OR "Fast-LeWM" OR "Latent Geometry Beyond Search")
dynamic_suggestions.why: Exact-family fallback if arXiv API tokenization under-recovers the LeWM name.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-lewm-limit-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs LeWorldModel (limitation OR collapse OR rollout OR planning)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Discover direct critiques, evaluations, and extensions of the focal model.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-lewm-calibration
dynamic_suggestions.why: Confirm exact method, mechanism, and follow-up terminology.

calibration_notes: arxiv calibration (high): Official arXiv record confirms LeWorldModel, LeWM, end-to-end JEPA, and the stable-from-pixels framing.
arxiv calibration (high): Official arXiv record confirms Fast LeWorldModel / Fast-LeWM and action-prefix prediction.
arxiv calibration (high): Official arXiv record confirms the direct LeWM planning follow-up and the Goal-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics Model (GC-IDM) term.
arxiv calibration (high): Official arXiv record confirms LeJEPA and Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg), the anti-collapse mechanism used by LeWM.
